title.head: Four residents, one DubaiNow.
title.sub: How the new core app and service library work for the people who use them.

personas.name: Khalid
personas.head: Seven entities. One journey.
personas.sub: Build a house takes him from plot to move-in, start to finish. Home tells him when it’s his turn.

personas.name: Faisal
personas.role: Café owner in Al Quoz, with two vans
personas.head: Every bill and fine. One tap.
personas.sub: Pay all clears the café’s DEWA and du bills and a fine on one of the vans, then asks how it went.
personas.service: Pay all your bills and fines
personas.meta: 13 kinds of bill, fine and top-up

personas.name: Sara
personas.head: Her family’s visas, renewed together.
personas.sub: Home spots two visas due in 73 days and offers to renew them in one go, medical tests and Emirates IDs included.

personas.name: Mahmoud
personas.role: Site technician, uses DubaiNow in Arabic
personas.head: Every screen, in his language.
personas.sub: Switch to Arabic and the whole app mirrors, right to left. Every service keeps its Arabic name, and search understands Arabic too.
personas.meta: Arabic and English, in every component

library.head: One library, three kinds of service.
library.sub: Every service is named for what it does, and sorted by how much it does for you.

end.head: The new DubaiNow.
end.sub: Built around what residents need to do.
end.meta: Core app and service library · Design preview · October 2026
